changes.summary: Adds immutable candidate-bound specs and audits, dataset provenance and contamination checks, crate-controlled observed execution with session binding, complete deterministic run commitments, causal failure harvesting, replay and grader controls, and paired promotion reconciliation issued only by an opaque crate-controlled independent-review authority. PromotionReview Debug is a bounded constant-redacted surface that cannot echo reviewer, authority, session, candidate, run, spec, journey, rollback, artifact, binding, review, or attestation fields.

Adds exact inventory snapshots, compatibility-route validation, and deterministic migration plans whose replacement/equivalence evidence is opaque, non-Clone, non-Serialize, non-Deserialize, and crate-issued only from root-observed behavior, representative journey, every named causal false-pass control, rollback execution, independent reviewer/session attestation, exact candidate/catalog/read-session inventory binding, bounded expiry/nonce, and a one-shot evidence ledger. Consumed evidence now lives only in a private non-clonable, non-serde plan ledger; public RetirementTarget contains one domain-separated replacement summary commitment and no token. MigrationPlan and RetirementTarget are themselves non-clonable and non-serde and expose deliberate cloneable/serde inspection DTOs that contain only counts, stable surface IDs, and domain-separated commitments and cannot reconstruct authority. Final reconciliation still uses the original private token and originating live ledger, atomically elects one winner, and revalidates around review and destructive-effect consumption.

Covers positive, negative, race/mutation, external replacement/review/effect mint-clone-deserialize attempts, compile failures for consumed-token/plan/target Clone+Serialize+Deserialize and projection-to-plan conversion, sentinel JSON non-traversal of every private consumed field, safe DTO roundtrip, projection substitution refusal, private-ledger mutation refusal, Arc-shared concurrent reconciliation without plan cloning, caller-supplied authority proxies, repeated-hash evidence, missing controls, dropped or rolled-back ledgers, revocation, cross-adapter replay, concurrent losers, post-check drift, bounded redacted Debug, mutate-restore, one-shot replay, expiry, effect conflicts, special-file, hardlink, path escape, contamination, nondeterminism, reward hacking, self-review, active authority, unauthorized retirement, and recursive zero-write cases.
